comment: The generator is at Melody.cpp:680 onwards. The starting note is drawn from the tonic, third, fifth or leading tone with odds that depend on the phrase length (Melody.cpp:709 to :722); the step from note to note is clamped between -2 and 4 scale degrees, tightened as the melody wanders from the tonic (Melody.cpp:736 to :739). A phrase of six notes or more reserves its last note for the tonic, and one of ten or more is steered to a cadence two notes from the end (Melody.cpp:730, :746). The four expression settings are gate fractions of 0.40, 0.60, 0.87 and 0.99 of the step, and the knob rescales smoothly between the first and the last of them rather than snapping (Melody.cpp:34 to :37, :212, :819). The CV jacks write their parameter with setValue rather than being summed with it (Melody.cpp:831, :840), so each takes its knob over. The phrase, its durations, accents and glides are all saved with the patch, one set per voice.
